title: Rabbi Chanina bar Agil
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Bava Kamma 54b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.54b.29)–[55a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.55a.1) he asked Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba: “Why is ‘good’ not stated in the first Commandments, while in the latter Commandments ‘good’ is stated?” He said to him: “… Go to Rabbi Tanchum bar Chanilai” — he went to him, etc. In [Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 6:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Yevamot.6.6.3): Rabbi Chanina bar Agul in the name of Rabbi Chizkiyah. He is mentioned in Midrash Abba Gurion on the verse “And when were fulfilled,” and there bar Igul; and in [Esther Rabbah 2:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Esther_Rabbah.2.5) the statement is attributed to Rabbi Chanina bar Atal.[^1]

notes.text: The Bavli writes Chanina ben Agil, and the next folio gives the reply and referral to Rabbi Tanchum. The Yerushalmi uses Agul and attributes his report to Chizkiyah. Esther Rabbah reads Atal. Hyman also reports Igul from Abba Gurion.
